purpose: Two-game pilot for predicting six tower HP values from confirmed deployment history

cautions: The parent two-game run failed while opening its next match; game_001 itself reached the overtime result screen and is complete.
Pixel 8 declared musketeer instead of the account's skeletons; confirmed actions and HP remain usable, but strict deck-conditioned training should filter or model this mismatch.

excluded.reason: Rejected: transient loss of both hand detections triggered the old early-stop rule while the physical match continued.

quality_notes: Tower HP is OCR-derived weak supervision; train with label_source and confidence as masks or weights.
Every accepted trajectory is within friendly-battle HP bounds and non-increasing.
Full-frame WEBP evidence and raw numeric OCR tokens are retained for future relabeling.
The reader supports dormant and activated king-bar positions; high-quality OCR decreases are accepted immediately.
Destroyed-tower zero boundaries were audited against saved frames: Game 1 sample 91 and Game 2 sample 28.
Game 1 team-right princess visibly changes from 106 to 31 HP at sample 72; that missed two-digit OCR interval is frame-audited.
Result/tiebreak rows have training_mask=false and all towers carry explicit training_weight values.
